scripts.build: esbuild src/content.js --bundle --outdir=dist && esbuild src/styles/content.css --bundle --outfile=dist/content.css --loader:.woff2=file --public-path=./ && cp -r assets/fonts dist/
scripts.build:prod: esbuild src/content.js --bundle --minify --outdir=dist && esbuild src/styles/content.css --bundle --minify --outfile=dist/content.css --loader:.woff2=file --public-path=./ && cp -r assets/fonts dist/
